brief.summary_1line: Ravana conquers many kings, defeats Ayodhya’s King Anaranya in battle, and the fallen monarch foretells Ravana’s future death by a descendant of his line.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana stands amid the battlefield as Anaranya’s vast army burns away before his forces like moths falling into a blazing fire.
King Anaranya releases a storm of arrows at Ravana, the shafts striking his body harmlessly like rain against a mountain peak.
Ravana strikes Anaranya from his chariot, the aged king crashing to the earth like a lightning-struck sala tree.
